meta.name: nestjs-expert
meta.description: Creates and configures NestJS modules, controllers, services, DTOs, guards, and interceptors for enterprise-grade TypeScript backend applications. Use when building NestJS REST APIs or GraphQL services, implementing dependency injection, scaffolding modular architecture, adding JWT/Passport authentication, integrating TypeORM or Prisma, or working with .module.ts, .controller.ts, and .service.ts files. Invoke for guards, interceptors, pipes, validation, Swagger documentation, and unit/E2E testing in NestJS projects.

copy.tagline_en: Generate backend modules and API code in TypeScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build enterprise TypeScript backend services

howto.what: Claude 会生成 NestJS 后端代码:按固定顺序产出模块、控制器、服务、DTO 和单元测试文件。它强制使用依赖注入、参数验证、Swagger 注释与类型化异常,并避免硬编码配置、循环依赖等问题。
howto.when: 当构建 NestJS REST API 或 GraphQL 服务、实现依赖注入、添加 JWT/Passport 认证,或提到“NestJS”“controller”等关键词时触发。操作 .module.ts 等文件也会接管。

say.text: 用 NestJS 给我建一个用户模块,包括控制器、服务和 DTO。
say.note: 会按模板生成对应文件及单元测试。

say.text: 给用户服务加上 JWT 登录认证和守卫。
say.note: 会添加 Passport/JWT 与 guard 代码。

say.text: 为 UsersService 写单元测试并运行 lint。
say.note: 会生成 spec 文件并执行 npm run lint。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate NestJS backend code: produce modules, controllers, services, DTOs, and unit tests in a fixed order. It enforces dependency injection, input validation, Swagger annotations, and typed exceptions, avoiding hardcoded config and circular dependencies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building NestJS REST/GraphQL services, implementing DI, adding JWT/Passport auth, or mentioning keywords like "NestJS". Also when editing .module.ts files.

say_en.text: Create a NestJS user module with controller, service, and DTO.
Add JWT login auth and a guard to the user service.
Write unit tests for UsersService and run lint.
say_en.note: Creates spec and runs npm run lint.
